# Ai Graphics LLC

> Custom apparel, uniform store, embroidery, and commercial printing company based in Homestead, Florida.

## About Ai Graphics
[Ai Graphics](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/) is a premier custom apparel and commercial printing company located in Homestead, FL, serving Miami-Dade County (Homestead, Florida City, Cutler Bay, Kendall, and Greater Miami) and offering nationwide shipping across the US. We specialize in high-quality commercial embroidery, Direct-to-Film (DTF) printing, window graphics, microperforado, banners, signs, and marketing promotional items.

## Contact Information
- Website: [Ai Graphics Official Website](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/)
- Phone / WhatsApp: [+1 (305) 970-5085](tel:+13059705085)
- Email: [Sales@aigraphicsfl.com](mailto:Sales@aigraphicsfl.com)
- Service Areas: Homestead, FL; Florida City, FL; Cutler Bay, FL; Kendall, FL; Miami, FL; Nationwide USA shipping.

## Core Products & Services

### 1. Impresión DTF (Direct-to-Film Printing)
- [Custom T-Shirts & Franelas](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#productos): Full-color transfers on 100% cotton, polyester, and dry-fit fabrics.
- [Workwear & Hi-Vis Polos](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#productos): Industrial-grade shirts with durable company logo printing.
- [Custom Hats & Caps](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#productos): Heat-press transfer printing on all styles of headwear.
- [School Uniforms & Senior Class](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#productos): Custom graduation and school spirit wear.

### 2. Bordado Computarizado (Custom Embroidery)
- [Custom Embroidered Caps](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#productos): Flat embroidery and 3D Puff high-relief embroidery on all styles of hats.
- [Corporate & Work Polos](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#productos): Professional stitching on polo shirts and workwear.
- [School Uniforms](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#productos): Embroidered crests, badges, skirts, and vests.
- [Outerwear & Jackets](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#productos): Heavy-duty jackets, hoodies, enguatadas, and custom patches.

### 3. Señalética & Gran Formato (Signs & Banners)
- [Microperforado (One-Way Vision)](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#productos): Perforated vinyl for commercial storefronts and vehicle rear windows.
- [Window Decals & Lettering](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#productos): Storefront vinyl graphics, hours, and branding.
- [Retractable Roll-Ups & Vinyl Banners](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#productos): Portable trade show displays and outdoor banners.
- [Rigid Signs](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#productos): Coroplast yard signs and PVC boards with UV laminate protection.

### 4. Marketing Products & Promocionales
- [Custom Die-Cut Stickers](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#productos): Waterproof vinyl stickers for products, cars, and branding.
- [Business Cards & Flyers](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#productos): Premium cardstock business cards and marketing flyers.
- [Displays](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#productos): PVC and foam board / foam counter signs.
- [Custom Drinkware](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#productos): Sublimation mugs and custom glassware.

## Turnaround & Order Policies
- Turnaround Time: Standard production is 3-5 business days.
- Rush Orders: Priority rush service (24-48 hours) is available with expedited rates upon request.
- Minimum Orders: Flexible on apparel and uniforms (no strict minimums). Specific minimums apply to items like stickers and business cards ([Contact Us](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/contact)).
- Local Pickup: Available in Homestead / South Florida area.
- Shipping: Nationwide delivery available.
- FAQs: [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.aigraphicsfl.com/#faqs)
